title: Deep Chand v. State of U.P.

content.caseIdentity: Deep Chand v. State of U.P., AIR 1959 SC 648
content.holding: Post-Constitution laws violating Article 13(2) are still-born and void ab initio; the Doctrine of Eclipse does not apply to revive them against citizens.
content.relevance: Established the still-born law doctrine for post-Constitution enactments.
